versions.changelog: Note the omem CLI is a prerequisite (SKILL.md) + handle 'command not found: omem' (troubleshooting). Docs-only patch.

OMem 1.0.0 — initial release

- Introduces a unified work memory search tool, abstracting emails, calendar events, documents, and collaboration notes into a local wiki.
- Supports a wide range of source types (mail, calendar, folders, Teams Loop), with future support for Slack, Jira, and Notion.
- Guides users to query work-related questions, with clear instructions on when to use (and not use) the skill.
- Details a four-level progressive disclosure workflow, from search abstracts to raw files.
- Emphasizes manual reranking of search results and depth-first follow-up for specific, unresolved references.
